description: OPTIONAL Meta SAM 3.1 cinematic segmentation/tracking layer. OFF by default (SAM_ENABLED=false); when disabled or unavailable the render falls back to the existing YOLO/tracking path untouched.
notes: Meta SAM 3.1 needs Python 3.12+/PyTorch 2.7+/CUDA 12.6+. Run it in an isolated interpreter (SAM_PYTHON_BIN) so the main CPU stack (torch 2.6.0+cpu, numpy<2, opencv-headless 4.10.0.84) stays untouched.
